description: Local MCP server for Weeek (stdio transport) — read-only by default, opt-in write tools.
name: io.github.YOLKINS/weeek-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Weeek Public API v1 access token. Required — the server refuses to start without it.
environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Gate for the write tools. Defaults to 'true': a fresh install exposes only the ten read tools. Set to 'false' to additionally expose the five write tools (create/update/move/complete a task, set an MR link) — an explicit operator opt-in, never the default.
environmentVariables.name: READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of tool names to register (still subject to READ_ONLY). Pair with READ_ONLY=false for a granular write rollout, e.g. 'weeek_complete_task'.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLED_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Override the Weeek API base URL. Defaults to the public v1 endpoint.
environmentVariables.name: WEEEK_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Upper bound on the JSON length of a single tool response, protecting the agent's context window from unbounded list/detail payloads.
environmentVariables.name: MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS
